note: No caption is printed in this crop. The crop is a chemical reaction scheme (two benzene-ring structures), so the labels are the printed formulae and names: the first NH2 sits on the left (aniline) ring, the second NH2 on the right (product) ring; the three Br labels are the 2-, 6- and 4-positions of the product ring (two upper, one lower). Subscripts are printed as subscripts (NH2, 3Br2, Br2/H2O).
